text: 韩国经济日报援引知情人士报道，韩国考虑大规模购买美国长期国债，以此增加其外汇储备并加强与华盛顿的经济联系。韩国政府和央行最近向美国提出了这一想法，美国给予了积极回应。购买的具体规模尚未确定，但预计韩国将至少购买数百亿美元的美国国债，足以显著提升其外汇储备。
text_en: The Korea Economic Daily, citing informed sources, reported that South Korea is considering large-scale purchases of US long-term Treasury bonds to increase its foreign exchange reserves and strengthen economic ties with Washington. The South Korean government and central bank recently proposed this idea to the United States, and the US responded positively. The specific scale of purchases has not yet been determined, but South Korea is expected to buy at least tens of billions of dollars of US Treasury bonds, enough to significantly boost its foreign exchange reserves.
